title: Kilauea Episode 45 — 270m lava fountain, April 23 2026
snippet: USGS HVO notice April 29, 2026 — Kilauea Episode 45 eruption began April 23 with 270-meter lava fountain at Halemaʻumaʻu crater. Continuation of ongoing summit eruption series following Episode 44 (src-005). Alert level remains at WARNING.
tag_reason: Update to existing Kilauea eruption series (src-005/ent-evt-004); Episode 45 follows Episode 44 with escalated activity.
